inputs.original_text: This isn’t really about deterring attacks. The bill would make death the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis, while the security argument serves as a convenient pitch for putting unequal justice into law. Ben-Gvir’s religious party introduced it, but the bigger prize is making an extreme use of state power seem like ordinary policy. Even the debate helps normalize it; opponents’ denunciations don’t change what the process is doing.
